CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hardware_reservation_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
 if tg_op<>'UPDATE' or old.state<>'held' or new.state not in ('released','expired','allocated') or new.row_version<>old.row_version+1
 or new.ended_at is null or (to_jsonb(new)-array['state','row_version','ended_at']) is distinct from (to_jsonb(old)-array['state','row_version','ended_at'])
 then raise exception 'reservation_history_immutable' using errcode='PT409';end if;
 return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hardware_reservation_payment_verified(p_order uuid, p_reservation uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$ select false $function$

relations.name: catalogue_variants
triggers: CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER reservation_consistency AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.catalogue_variants DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION hardware_reservation_check()
constraints: CHECK (((lead_time_days_min IS NULL) OR (lead_time_days_max IS NULL) OR (lead_time_days_min <= lead_time_days_max)))
CHECK ((((price_ngn_kobo IS NULL) = (vat_treatment IS NULL)) AND ((vat_treatment IS NULL) = (vat_rate_bp IS NULL))))
FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES catalogue_products(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (supplier_id) REFERENCES office_suppliers(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
